findings.evidence: Proof at OnCurve.lean:183-186 uses only `realWindingIntegrand_def`, `Complex.abs_im_le_norm`, `norm_mul`, `norm_inv`; `Integrand.lean:7` imports `Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic`, which pulls in `Mathlib/Analysis/RCLike/Basic.lean:694`/`Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Norm.lean:185` (`abs_im_le_norm`), so no new import is needed. `Integrand.lean` is transitively public-imported via `RealIntegral/Basic.lean:9`, so OnCurve gains no import either.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Winding/Integrand.lean`, next to `realWindingIntegrand_mul_mul` and the two pointwise lemmas this PR already adds there, and make it public.
findings.issue: `abs_realWindingIntegrand_le_div_of_norm_le` is a pointwise fact about the definition alone (`|realWindingIntegrand z v| ≤ ‖v‖ / m` for `m ≤ ‖z‖`) with no curve, crossing or winding content; it is private in the top file of the tower.

findings.evidence: Proof at OnCurve.lean:112-116 uses only `exists_continuousOn_arg_lift_with_partition` (`Argument/Lift.lean:377`) and `integral_inv_sub_mul_deriv_eq_log_norm_add_I_mul_sum_log_im` (`Winding/SegmentSum.lean:150`). `Winding/Integer.lean:8-10` imports SegmentSum + Argument.Lift and computes the same log-norm difference at `Integer.lean:117`; `RealIntegral/Basic.lean:8` publicly imports `Winding.Integer`, so OnCurve would need no new import.
findings.fix: Move it (public) to `Winding/SegmentSum.lean` — the file whose topic is exactly this real/imaginary decomposition — adding `import TauCeti.Analysis.Contour.Argument.Lift` there (acyclic: `Argument/Lift.lean` imports only Mathlib and `Curve/Distance`); or to `Winding/Integer.lean`, which already imports both and derives the same real-part cancellation inline.
findings.issue: `re_integral_inv_sub_mul_deriv_eq_log_norm` states a general branch-free fact about the index integral of an *avoiding* curve (`(∫ (γ - s)⁻¹ * deriv γ).re = log‖γ u - s‖ - log‖γ l - s‖`) — no immersion, no crossings, nothing from this file's subject. It depends on no theory later than `Winding/SegmentSum` and `Argument/Lift`, yet is private in the on-curve crossing file.

findings.evidence: OnCurve.lean:196-202 mentions only `DifferentiableOn`, `LipschitzOnWith`, `derivWithin`, `Icc`, `ℝ≥0`; its sole consumer sites feed `_corner` (OnCurve.lean:279-289), whose `hdiffR/hlipR/hdiffL/hlipL` binders are literally its four components (`LipschitzBoundedIntegrand.lean`, `_corner` signature).
findings.fix: Define it in `TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Winding/LipschitzBoundedIntegrand.lean` next to `exists_isBounded_image_realWindingIntegrand_of_lipschitzOnWith_derivWithin_corner` whose hypotheses it abbreviates, and change OnCurve.lean:15 to `public import` since it appears in public signatures there.
findings.issue: `IsLipschitzOnEachSideAt` is a public, generically named curve-regularity predicate (differentiability plus Lipschitz `derivWithin` on a one-sided window each side) with no winding-number or real-integral content, defined in the topmost file of the import tower. It packages exactly the hypotheses of `..._derivWithin_corner`, so a future consumer of that boundedness theorem cannot state its hypothesis in packaged form without importing the whole on-curve formula.

summary: The RealIntegral directory move and the new file's imports are correct, but three general-purpose declarations are stranded in the deepest assembly file (Winding/RealIntegral/OnCurve.lean) instead of the earlier files whose topic and dependencies fit them.
